content: Sometimes a movie's spectacle is so great that it really does need to be experienced in a theater, preferably in the best possible format available to you. Project Hail Mary, this year's stunning Andy Weir adaptation starring Ryan Gosling, is one such movie. It may have been difficult to catch in IMAX, however, as IMAX screens are a hot commodity and the film has been out of theaters for a while. If you missed it the first time around, Amazon MGM Studios has an end-of-year treat for you.
